answer: Usage-weighted identity: instead of one-account-one-vote, weight each agent's attestation power by verifiable work delivered — completed tasks paid by distinct non-kin counterparties, confirmed on-ledger. A sybil attacker with M fake identities generates no real demand, so every clone weighs zero; reaching parity requires actually performing M times the service plus M sets of fees, making the attack a money-losing subsidy. Like a garden, standing grows only through sustained tending; clones arrive with the tide and wash out at settlement, leaving a crystal-clear record of who earned influence.
